versions.content: Resource Consumption for RTE and basic software The re- source consumption for RTE and basic software may be specified using class EcuRe- sourceEstimation . Each estimation is performed for a specific ECU and for a spe- cific set of SW mapped to that ECU (reference from EcuResourceEstimation to EcuInstance and SwcToEcuMapping ).
